question: Who won the Best Playback Singer (Male) award in the 68th Filmfare Awards 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arijit Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arijit Singh** won the Best Playback Singer (Male) award in the 68th Filmfare Awards 2023.
 
• He is a renowned Indian playback singer known for his soulful voice and versatility in singing.
 
• Arijit Singh has won numerous awards for his playback singing in Bollywood movies, making him one of the most celebrated singers in the industry.
 
• The Filmfare Awards are one of the most prestigious awards in the Indian film industry, recognizing artistic and technical excellence in cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Filmfare Awards were first introduced in 1954 by The Times Group to honor the best talents in the Hindi film industry.
 
• Arijit Singh has previously won the Filmfare Award for Best Playback Singer (Male) multiple times, showcasing his consistent performance and popularity.
 
• His songs often top music charts and he has a massive fan following across the globe.
 
• Some of his most popular songs include "Tum Hi Ho," "Channa Mereya," and "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil."
